name: Saerbeck (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Saerbeck (a yellow wavy bar and three flowers on red).
history: Municipal flag of Saerbeck; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Saerbeck arms — wavy bar and flowers on red
